summary: CodeRabbit reviews public repositories for free, including AI reviews, slop detection, triage, Change Stack, and Security. No card or application. The $10M figure is CodeRabbit’s overall OSS commitment, not a per-project grant. OSS rate limits depend on community/popularity. Public repositories with fewer than 10 stars require manual review triggering; automatic next-PR reviews are not guaranteed for these repositories. Paid on-demand security scan products are separate from the advertised free PR-review features.
claim_steps: Install CodeRabbit from the GitHub or GitLab marketplace and enable it for the public repository; no paid subscription or card required for OSS.
Open a PR. For repositories with fewer than 10 stars, choose Trigger review in the status comment or comment @coderabbitai review (or @coderabbitai full review for a full review).
Stay within current OSS review/file/chat rate limits; inspect the official plans page for model/community-dependent limits.
